fields.name: showTitle
fields.label: Show the title
fields.description: On unless switched off. Off = hide the title on this section.

fields.name: showSubtitle
fields.label: Show the sub-title
fields.description: On unless switched off. Off = hide the sub-title on this section.

fields.name: showBody
fields.label: Show the body text
fields.description: On unless switched off. Off = hide the body on this section.

fields.name: foldBody
fields.label: Fold the body (reveal on click)
fields.description: Off = body shows straight away (normal). On = body starts hidden behind a small cue and opens when a visitor clicks it. Leave off for one-line sections and the contact block.

fields.name: cueStyle
fields.label: Reveal cue style

options.label: Dot — one breathing dot (default, most subtle)
Dots — a trio of dots (a little more explicit)
Dot + word — dot beside a short word (clearest)

fields.description: Only used when 'Fold the body' is on. How visible the click-to-open cue is.

fields.name: cueLabel
fields.label: Reveal cue word
fields.description: Only used with the 'Dot + word' cue. The short word beside the dot — e.g. More (EN) / Mehr (DE). Defaults to More/Mehr if left empty.

fields.name: cueLabelOpen
fields.label: Reveal cue word — open
fields.description: Only used with the 'Dot + word' cue. The word shown once open — e.g. Less (EN) / Weniger (DE). Defaults to Less/Weniger if left empty.

fields.name: groups
fields.label: Folding groups (optional)
fields.description: Higher-order areas shown on screen. Click one and its sub-areas unfold; the previously open one folds. Use INSTEAD of a long sub-title list.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Group description (one line, optional)
fields.description: Shown under the group name when it opens.

fields.name: showIntro
fields.label: Show this group's description
fields.description: Off = hide just this group's description, keep its name. (Needs the master 'Show group descriptions' on.)

fields.name: handled
fields.label: What we do + what stays with you (optional)

fields.name: showCopy
fields.label: Show this sub-area's description
fields.description: Off = show just the name. Use to keep 2-3 flagship items per group and leave the rest as names. (Needs the master 'Show sub-area descriptions' on.)

fields.name: showGroupIntros
fields.label: Show group descriptions (master)
fields.description: Master switch for the one-line description under each group name.

fields.name: showItemCopy
fields.label: Show sub-area descriptions (master)
fields.description: Master switch for the problem / what-we-do text under each sub-area.

fields.name: meta
fields.label: Meta line (optional)
fields.description: Small, quiet line under the body — location, signature. Sized with the contact links, not the body copy.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Contact Phone (optional)
fields.description: Renders as a tap-to-call link. Leave empty until a company number exists — do not publish a private mobile.

fields.name: ctaLabel
fields.label: Button label (optional)
fields.description: Leave empty for no button. Fill in to show a link button under this section — e.g. 'How we handle your data'.

fields.name: ctaUrl
fields.label: Button link (optional)
fields.description: Where the button goes — e.g. /data. A '/…' link is prefixed with /de automatically on the German site. A '/data' button hides itself automatically when the Data Page is switched off.

fields.name: subTitle
fields.label: Sub-title (above the steps)
fields.description: Says what the flow is FOR. Use | for line breaks; a segment of only dots renders as a drawn divider.

fields.name: dotsPerConnector
fields.label: Dots between each step
fields.description: Default 4. Fewer dots = sparser, cleaner look; more = denser.

fields.name: dotSize
fields.label: Dot size (px)
fields.description: Default 3.

fields.name: dotRestOpacity
fields.label: Resting dot opacity (0–1)
fields.description: Default 0.14. Lower = lighter grey at rest.

fields.name: dotPeakOpacity
fields.label: Lit dot opacity (0–1)
fields.description: Default 0.9. How dark a dot gets as the flow passes through it.

fields.name: flowSpeed
fields.label: Seconds per connector
fields.description: Default 2. How long the flow takes to cross each connector — controls overall pacing.

fields.name: connectorGap
fields.label: Gap between dots (px)
fields.description: Default 8. Direct spacing between adjacent dots.

fields.name: stepSpacing
fields.label: Space around each step label (px)
fields.description: Default 12. Padding on the side facing the connector — the main driver of total distance between step texts (combined with the dot gap above).

fields.name: content
fields.label: Explainer text (use | for line breaks)
fields.description: Optional. Sits under the drawn steps. A segment made only of dots (... / .. / .) renders as a drawn dot divider.

fields.name: ctaLabel
fields.label: Button label (optional)
fields.description: e.g. Start the Fit Check. Leave empty for no button.

fields.name: ctaUrl
fields.label: Button link (optional)
fields.description: e.g. /check — the /de prefix is added automatically on the German page.

options.label: In preparation — not yet commercially active (RAV wording)

fields.name: siteStatusContent
fields.label: Site status — custom wording (optional)
fields.description: Leave everything empty to use the built-in bilingual defaults. Fill only the lines you want to override.

fields.description: e.g. Practical AI automation | for small business

fields.name: showLogo
fields.label: Show logo mark in header (alongside wordmark)

fields.name: enableThemeToggle
fields.label: Show visitor light/dark toggle (sun/moon icon)
fields.description: When on, visitors see a sun/moon icon in the header. It always starts showing your Theme setting above ("Current"), correctly iconed as sun or moon depending on how light or dark that theme actually reads. A visitor can click through to a fixed plain white or fixed plain black view and back — those two fixed views never use your custom colours above, only your Theme setting does. Their choice is remembered for their next visit; turning this off here always shows everyone your Theme setting again, regardless of anything a visitor previously chose.

fields.name: enableLogoAnimation
fields.label: Header logo draws itself in on load
fields.description: Off = logo appears instantly, no ink-draw effect.

fields.name: enableStatusDot
fields.label: Breathing status dot beside the wordmark
fields.description: Off = wordmark shown with no dot.

fields.name: enableCascadeReveal
fields.label: Case Study fields reveal line-by-line
fields.description: Off = each field fades in as one block, same as other sections.

fields.name: enableTextHover
fields.label: Text lines grow slightly on hover
fields.description: Off = body text and case-study lines have no hover effect.

fields.name: enableCheckPageAnimations
fields.label: Fit Check page (/check): enable header animations
fields.description: Controls the logo ink-draw, breathing status dot, and page load-fade on the Fit Check page only — independent of the equivalent toggles above, which only affect the home page. Off by default (opt-in, not opt-out like every other toggle here): Fit Check is a conversion-focused page, and starts calm/instant rather than inheriting the home page's animate-by-default behaviour.

fields.name: backgroundStyle
fields.label: Background style
fields.description: Only one animated background can run at a time — both are three.js WebGL renderers, and running two simultaneously doubles the render cost for no visual benefit. Choose which one (if any) plays behind the whole page. Requires 'three' installed (npm install three).

fields.name: processFlow
fields.label: Process Flow Animation
fields.description: Per-block tuning (dot count, size, speed, spacing) lives on each Process Flow section itself, in the Pages collection — this only controls whether the sequence-lighting effect runs at all.

fields.name: enabled
fields.label: Dots light up in sequence on Process Flow connectors
fields.description: Off = connectors shown as plain static dots.

fields.name: depthBackground
fields.label: Depth Network Background
fields.description: Only used when Background style above is set to 'Depth network'.

fields.name: nodeCount
fields.label: Number of points
fields.description: Default 90. Higher = denser field, more render cost.

fields.name: connectDistance
fields.label: Connection distance
fields.description: Default 5.4. Higher = more lines drawn between points (denser web).

fields.name: lineOpacity
fields.label: Line opacity (0–1)
fields.description: Default 0.16. How visible the connecting lines are.

fields.name: nodeOpacity
fields.label: Point opacity (0–1)
fields.description: Default 0.75. How visible the points themselves are.

fields.name: nodeColor
fields.label: Point colour override
fields.description: Leave empty to auto-match the theme's text colour.

fields.name: fogColor
fields.label: Fog colour override
fields.description: Leave empty to auto-match the theme's background colour. Also used as the fog colour for Planetary Systems, if that's the active background instead.

fields.name: planetarySystems
fields.label: Planetary Systems Background
fields.description: Only used when Background style above is set to 'Planetary systems'.

fields.name: systemCount
fields.label: Number of systems
fields.description: Default 4.

fields.name: maxPlanets
fields.label: Max planets per system
fields.description: Default 4. Each system gets a random count from 1 up to this, for natural variety.

fields.name: orbitMinRadius
fields.label: Orbit distance, minimum (0–1)
fields.description: Default 0.35. Fraction of the base orbit size — how close the nearest planet can sit to its star.

fields.name: orbitMaxRadius
fields.label: Orbit distance, maximum (0–1)
fields.description: Default 1. How far the outermost planet can sit from its star.

fields.name: starColor
fields.label: Star colour override
fields.description: Leave empty to auto-match the theme's text colour. Planets and orbit paths derive from this same colour at lower opacity.

fields.name: pathOpacity
fields.label: Orbit path opacity (0–1)
fields.description: Default 0.12. How visible the faint orbit rings are.
